description: Batch of landed changes waiting for the next full CI run. Append with `python3 tools/ci_pending.py add ...`; tools/ci.sh archives this file to runs/ci/<run-id>/pending.json and resets it at the start of every run. See docs/CI-WORKFLOW.md.
